results.description:
Scientist Summer Daniels is a witness to a bombing by an ex-employee who now wants her dead. Luke “Wiseman” Arroyo is a broken Navy SEAL on the verge of quitting HERO Force who must now stay and protect her. They'll work together to find a rare element stolen during the attack, but Luke’s hiding a bombshell secret that could detonate a lot more than the explosive chemistry between them. He killed her brother in action.

Protecting His Witness is the first book in the Shattered SEALs military suspense series. If you like heroism, intrigue, and spicy romance, then you’ll love this heart-wrenching spinoff of Amy Gamet’s gripping HERO Force series. Buy Protecting His Witness and enter a world full of raw emotion and hot action today!
